title: Human-machine collaborative model for intangible cultural heritage pattern generation
summary: A paper uses GANs to learn traditional cultural patterns and generate new design variations, with human feedback via RLHF steering outputs toward aesthetic coherence and perceived cultural fidelity.
tweetText:
AI in cultural heritage is moving from digitization to interpretation.

New paper uses GANs + human feedback to translate heritage patterns into design. The test: can AI extend tradition without flattening memory?
